title: The Tick App: Changing Behaviors With Educational Messaging
official: The Use of Ecological Momentary Assessments to Assess Tick-borne Disease Risk
summary: The goal of this work is to evaluate the use of ecological momentary assessments as a tool to assess risk and risk factors for tick encounters and tick-borne diseases. This study will be conducted across the United States, with a focus the upper Midwest and Northeast and with a focus on Wisconsin and will enroll up to 1000 people.

interventions.name: Educational Materials delivered via the Tick App

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Will to participate in 7 days worth of daily activity logs within the Tick App.
* be able and willing to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Completes less than 7 days worth of daily logs or completes 7+ daily logs but not within 12 months.
